Task instance batch number of the instance generated
Task code of the task which refers to this variable
Instance code of the task instance which refers to this variable

Business time of the task instance.Business time is defined as the starting time of the task's frequency cycle.    If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM    For daily task the business time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00    For weekly task the business time is the Monday 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-05-31 00:00:00    For monthly task, the business time is 0AM of 1st day of the month of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-01 00:00:00    For hourly task, the business time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
Date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210603
Previous month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202105
Previous date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210531
Previous hour of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMddhh, e.g. 2021053109
Year of the current task instance business time, format yyyy, e.g. 2020
Month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202005
Date of the current task instance business time, format dd, e.g. 30
Hour of the current task instance business time , format hh, eg: 18

The time of a day a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched. If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the scheduled time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the schedule time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd. The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.

The time of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met. If the start run time is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the start run time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the start run time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.

content:
-- **************************************************************************
-- ** Theme Domain|所属业务主题: Risk ads
-- ** Functional description|功能描述: Risk feature中间表
-- ** Target table name|目标表名: ads_risk_${table_region}_mp_user_df
-- ** Create Author|创建人: hejia.an
-- ** Create time|创建日期: 2025-10-20
-- ** Modified log|修改日志:
-- **             修改日期: 2025-10-20  修改人:hejia.an  新建内容: 以mp user作为user base，以解决大宽表内，whitelist信息不完整的问题
-- **             修改日期: 2025-11-06  修改人:hejia.an  修改内容: 增加user level freeze status
-- **             修改日期: 2025-11-27  修改人:hejia.an  修改内容: 源表切换为credit_uc.dws_uc_${table_region}_user_lock_status_df
-- ** @extra_input=xxx
-- ** @extra_input=xxx
-- **************************************************************************

-- drop table if exists ${SCHEMA}.ads_risk_${table_region}_mp_user_df;

-- create external table if not exists ${SCHEMA}.ads_risk_${table_region}_mp_user_df (
--     platform_user_id string comment 'shopee user id'
--     ,is_whitelist_spl int comment 'Whether user is in whitelist'
--     ,whitelist_time_spl string comment 'Whitelist time'
--     ,is_whitelist_bcl int comment 'Whether user is in whitelist'
--     ,whitelist_time_bcl string comment 'Whitelist time'
--     ,is_whitelist_splx int comment 'Whether user is in whitelist'
--     ,whitelist_time_splx  string comment 'Whitelist time'
--     ,is_post_kyc_freeze                     int             comment 'Whether post kyc freeze'
--     ,is_post_fraud_freeze                   int             comment 'Whether post fraud freeze'
--     ,is_overdue_freeze                   int             comment 'Whether overdue freeze'
--     ,is_restructure_freeze                         int             comment 'Whether under restructure program'
--     ,is_dpd_freeze                         int             comment 'Whether ALL DPD 60 Freeze'
-- )
-- partitioned by (
--     grass_date string 
-- ) 
-- stored as orc 
-- comment 'whitelist & user level info of mp user summary table'
-- tblproperties
-- (
--     "orc.compress" = "zstd"
--     ,"orc.stripe.size" = "268635456"
-- )
-- location '${HDFS_PATH}/risk_feature/ads/ads_risk_${table_region}_mp_user_df/grass_region=${region}';

-- msck repair table ${SCHEMA}.ads_risk_${table_region}_mp_user_df;

insert overwrite table ${SCHEMA}.ads_risk_${table_region}_mp_user_df partition (grass_date = '${ds}')
select 
    t1.platform_user_id
    ,t2.is_whitelist_spl 
    ,t2.whitelist_time_spl
    ,t2.is_whitelist_bcl 
    ,t2.whitelist_time_bcl
    ,t2.is_whitelist_splx
    ,t2.whitelist_time_splx
    ,t3.is_post_kyc_freeze
    ,t3.is_post_fraud_freeze
    ,t3.is_overdue_freeze
    ,t3.is_restructure_freeze
    ,t3.is_dpd_freeze
from
(
    select
        distinct cast(user_id as string) as platform_user_id
    from mp_user.dim_user__reg_s0_live
    where 
        grass_region = '${region}' 
        and grass_date = '${ds}'
) t1 
left join 
(
    select 
        platform_user_id
        ,is_whitelist_spl 
        ,to_date(first_whitelist_local_time_spl) as whitelist_time_spl
        ,is_whitelist_bcl 
        ,to_date(first_whitelist_local_time_bcl) as whitelist_time_bcl
        ,is_whitelist_chp as is_whitelist_splx
        ,to_date(first_whitelist_local_time_chp) as whitelist_time_splx
    from credit_uc.ads_${table_region}_uc_user_list_wide_df -- 产品横表，splx在这张表里记为chp
    where grass_date = '${ds}' 
) t2
on t1.platform_user_id = t2.platform_user_id
left join 
(
    select 
        platform_user_id
        ,max(is_post_kyc_freeze) as is_post_kyc_freeze -- kyc冻结
        ,max(is_post_fraud_freeze) as is_post_fraud_freeze -- 反欺诈冻结
        ,max(is_overdue_freeze) as is_overdue_freeze -- overdue冻结
        ,max(is_restructure_freeze) as is_restructure_freeze -- User is under restructure program
        ,max(is_dpd_freeze) as is_dpd_freeze -- ALL DPD 60 Freeze
    from credit_uc.dws_uc_${table_region}_user_lock_status_df 
    where grass_date = '${ds}' 
    group by platform_user_id -- user粒度冻结
) t3
on t1.platform_user_id = t3.platform_user_id
